notes: DEMO SAMPLE DATA: synthetic fixture for dashboard development. Every number, PR and date is fabricated and must not be read as real team activity or findings.
Ownership attribution: team-assets label or the supplied author roster (label/roster attribution, not historically proven org ownership).

Reviewed PR counts dedupe team reviews per PR per month; repeat months count independently. Submitted reviews include APPROVED, CHANGES_REQUESTED, COMMENTED and historically submitted dismissed reviews where recoverable; pending and self-reviews are excluded.
reviewedUnmergedPrs is a snapshot of merge status at generation time, not historical month-end state.
mergedExternalReviewedPrs counts external PRs merged in the month with a qualifying team review at or before merge; internal merged throughput does not require a review.
Provenance: dashboard schema adapted from the assets review velocity extraction reference (2026-03-02); this fixture is synthetic.
